```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = F)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)
```

<i>Warning: if you'd like to use this file as pdf, you can click CTRL+P to print, then select "Print to PDF".</i>


```{r, out.width="100%", warning=F}

MapList <- list()

for(SP in sort(unique(c(dist$sci_name, pts$sci_name)))){
  
  ControlPts<-ControlPoly<-F
  
  # Prepare distribution
  distSP <- dist[dist$sci_name==SP,]
  
  # Prepare points
  ptsSP <- pts[pts$sci_name==SP,]
  
  # Prepare Leaflet
  Leaf_map <- leaflet() %>%
    addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldTopoMap", options = providerTileOptions(opacity=0.5))
  
  # Add polygons to leaflet
  if(is.null(distSP)==F){
    if(nrow(distSP)>0){
      distSP$Popup <- paste0("<b>POLYGON</b><br>",
                             "Presence: ", distSP$presence, "<br>",
                             "Origin: ", distSP$origin, "<br>",
                             "Seasonal: ", distSP$seasonal, "<br>")
      
      Leaf_map <- Leaf_map %>% addPolygons(data=distSP, color=distSP$cols, stroke=T, weight=2, fillOpacity=0.5, group="Range map", popup=distSP$Popup, popupOptions = popupOptions(autoPan=T, keepInView = T, closeOnClick=T))
      
      ControlPoly<-T
    }}
    
  
  # Add points to leaflet
  if(is.null(ptsSP)==F){
    if(nrow(ptsSP)>0){
      
      ptsSP <-ptsSP %>% st_as_sf(., coords = c("dec_long","dec_lat"), remove = FALSE, crs=st_crs(4326))
      
      ptsSP$Popup <- paste0("<b>POINT RECORD</b><br>",
                            "Presence: ", ptsSP$presence, "<br>",
                            "Origin: ", ptsSP$origin, "<br>",
                            "Seasonal: ", ptsSP$seasonal, "<br>")
      ControlPts<-T
      
      Leaf_map <- Leaf_map %>%
        addCircleMarkers(data=ptsSP, fillColor=ptsSP$cols, stroke=T, color="grey", weight=2, radius=5, popup=ptsSP$Popup, group="Point records", popupOptions = popupOptions(autoPan=T, keepInView = T, closeOnClick=T))
    }}
  
  # Add Layer control
  CONTROL <- c(ifelse(ControlPoly==T, "Range map", NA), ifelse(ControlPts==T, "Point records", NA)) %>% subset(., is.na(.)==F)
  
  Leaf_map <- Leaf_map %>%
        addLayersControl(overlayGroups = CONTROL, position="topleft", options=layersControlOptions(collapsed=F))
  
  # Save in list
  MapList[[length(MapList)+1]] <- list(
    htmltools::h2(SP), 
    Leaf_map
  )
  
}

tagList(MapList)

```
